title: Gaussian splat renderer package integrated with a sample scene
summary: Integrate a Unity Gaussian splat renderer (MIT or compatible; aras-p UnityGaussianSplatting lineage as the candidate) pinned by commit, with a small sample splat rendering in a test scene on the reference Android device at 30 fps. The package choice is recorded as an addendum to ADR-0001 through an AUTH (design-change) filed via the Foreman.

acceptance_tests.test: Renderer package added to Packages/manifest.json by git URL pinned to a commit SHA; LICENSE file included; license is MIT/BSD/Apache-2.0.
A sample splat (≤ 10 MB, self-captured or public domain, no faces or private documents visible) renders in unity/Assets/Capture/Samples/SplatSample.unity in the Editor.

The sample scene meets the SPEC §6 targets on the Owner's iPhones (60 fps on a current model, 30 fps on an older one), measured with the debug overlay or Profiler when a device and a TestFlight build are available (suggested).
ADR-0001 addendum names the package, commit, license, and the fallback (textured-mesh visuals on low-end devices); the PR cites the APPROVED #n for that design change.
Splat LOD/culling knobs are exposed in a single ScriptableObject so gj-gameplay can tune them later.

auth_required.what: ADR-0001 addendum: splat renderer package choice

history.event: AUTH #003 applied: acceptance-criterion levels added; iOS-only wording

open -> in-review (gj-operator; direct commit to main, Operator precedent; the branch field names the work stream for the validator, no separate branch is pushed). AT-1 met: aras-p/UnityGaussianSplatting (org.nesnausk.gaussian-splatting, package.json 1.1.1) added to unity/Packages/manifest.json as a git URL pinned to commit 2c6fed37da67a217367261fcfcd3316d34c73e76 (packages-lock.json hash matches), plus the built-in com.unity.modules.vr 1.0.0 that it needs. License MIT (LICENSE.md ships in the package; bundled GPUSorting and TinyJson code is MIT). EditMode tests assert the SHA pin and the MIT license. AT-2 met: unity/Assets/Capture/Samples/SplatSample.unity renders the procedural sample gj_sample_summit (38,460 splats, 1.9 MB converted; self-generated by Assets/Editor/Splats/SampleSplat.cs with seed 20260927, so no captured imagery, faces or documents; no .ply/.spz tracked; deterministic rebuild) in the Editor, 6000.0.84f1, Vulkan/lavapipe. 31.37% of pixels differ from a splat-off baseline. Screenshot: qa/evidence/M0-UNITY-02/splat-sample-editor.png. AT-5 met: one ScriptableObject, Assets/Settings/SplatRenderSettings.asset (GiganticJourneys.Splats.SplatRenderSettings), holds per-tier SH order, splat/opacity scale, sort cadence, splat budget and max render distance, plus frustum culling. SplatRenderSettingsApplier applies it. URP wiring: GaussianSplatURPFeature on the Low/Medium/High renderers through ProjectSetup.EnsureSplatFeature. Local EditMode 12/12 (6 new SplatRendererTests) and PlayMode 1/1. AT-3 (suggested) not measured: no device build yet, and iOS correctness belongs to M1-UNITY-01 (upstream Metal sort issue #226). AT-4 NOT met: the Operator was told the Owner approved this design change on 2026-09-27, but no written ADR-0001 addendum proposal or Pending AUTH existed to attach the approval to. The proposed addendum text is filed at governance/auth-requests/M0-UNITY-02-adr-0001-addendum.md for the Owner to confirm. No AUTH number is assigned and ADR-0001 is unchanged until the Coordinator logs the approval. Finding: the renderer's compute shaders use DXC with wave intrinsics and do not compile for OpenGL Core. On a GPU-less Linux box the Editor must run Vulkan on lavapipe with -force-vulkan -force-device-index 0 (without the index Unity skips the CPU Vulkan device).

Follow-up (gj-operator): the sample asset's m_DataHash changed on every re-import even though the data bytes were identical. The upstream converter hashes the chunk NativeArray handle, a memory address, rather than its contents. SampleSplat.ConvertPly now sets a content hash over the five data files (SampleSplat.SetContentHash); the renderer uses the hash only to detect changed data. Rebuilds and the M0-QA-01 smoke now leave the committed sample byte-identical, .asset included.

Owner approval recorded (gj-operator). At 11:37 AM CT the Owner wrote in the operator chat, verbatim: "Approved: ADR-0001 addendum (M0-UNITY-02)". That approves the addendum text in governance/auth-requests/M0-UNITY-02-adr-0001-addendum.md as written. Bots may not write the AUTHORIZATION_LOG Decisions table, assign AUTH numbers, or add Pending rows (Foreman/Coordinator only). ADR-0001 is a protected path whose commit must cite APPROVED #n. So auth_required[0] stays pending.
